issues.description: Close message type does not match Deepgram's documented CloseStream control message
issues.detail: The PR description and Deepgram API state the control message should be {"type": "CloseStream"}, but _CLOSE_MSG is defined as {"type": "Close"}. If the server ignores unknown types, the close-stream behavior won't actually trigger and the fix is silently a no-op. Verify against the Speak WebSocket docs and align the string.

issues.description: Single ws.receive() with 1s timeout may consume audio frame instead of close ack
issues.detail: After sending Flush+Close, the server may emit additional audio binary frames before any close acknowledgment. A single receive() will pop one of those frames and discard it, potentially truncating audio that was being awaited by the caller. Consider a short drain loop until a Close/CLOSE frame is observed or timeout elapses.

issues.description: Broad except Exception swallows cancellation-relevant errors
issues.detail: The try/except wraps awaits including asyncio.wait_for; catching bare Exception is fine for CancelledError in 3.8+ but the warning log on benign ConnectionResetError during shutdown will be noisy. Consider catching (aiohttp.ClientError, ConnectionError, OSError) explicitly, or downgrading to debug for expected disconnect errors.

issues.description: send_str may raise if socket already closed, masking the close path
issues.detail: If the upstream has already closed the ws (e.g., on error path), send_str will raise ConnectionResetError and skip both messages. The finally still closes, so behavior is acceptable, but consider checking ws.closed before sending to avoid the warning log on every normal error-path teardown.

issues.description: f-string in logger.warning bypasses lazy formatting
issues.detail: logger.warning(f"...{e}") evaluates the string regardless of log level. Minor, but the codebase likely uses logger.warning("...%s", e) or exception() elsewhere. Using logger.exception would also capture traceback for diagnosing close-sequence failures.

review.summary: The fix correctly adds graceful shutdown messaging before closing the Deepgram TTS WebSocket, but the _CLOSE_MSG string ({"type":"Close"}) appears to diverge from the PR description and Deepgram docs which specify "CloseStream" — worth verifying since a mismatch would make this fix a silent no-op. The single 1-second ws.receive() may also consume a pending audio frame rather than the intended close acknowledgment, potentially worsening truncation in some cases. Remaining concerns are minor: broad exception handling, send on potentially-closed sockets, and non-lazy log formatting.
